notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update 18 | 10 New Languages Added!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=IVeS2NO-LVQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Hi everyone and welcome to this short dev update on Outliver: Tribulation, an atmospheric, story-driven, action-adventure third-person shooter that blends gameplay elements and combat styles from the Survival-Horror and Souls-like genres with African mythology where you play as the soldier who mysteriously ends up in a supernatural realm, of which her only way out is to partake in an ancient ritual....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/f0ec868cf08139e8bfc8d64fd0fcaebffe203399.jpg[/img]
In this update, we focused primarily on adding support for multiple languages to make the game more accessible to a wider audience as some gamers have suggested. After much deliberation, we decided to add up to 10 languages and we are pleased to announce that Outliver: Tribulation now officially supports French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Turkish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/cfc2022d3956c494c51ce0cd5a496158024b8312.jpg[/img]
We also added a quality of life/convenience feature that makes it easy for new gamers especially those struggling with the English language to avoid the trouble of having to painstakingly navigate around menus to select their preferred language. We call it the "First Launch Language Setup Prompt", and as the name implies, when the game is launched for the first time, this window pops up to allow the gamer to select a preferred language before the main menu is revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/4bbe19ba9ca56538ecfe1d7890396a6769a88a01.jpg[/img]
As always, we will continue to support Outliver: Tribulation and keep you all updated as we progress. So, if you haven't already, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/czHZwNkMb6]Discord server[/url] using the provided link. We’d love to have you there and hear your opinions and feedback. Head over to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236930/Outliver_Tribulation/]Steam [/url]now to get your copy of Outliver: Tribulation. I would also like to thank everyone who has supported us so far by getting a copy of the game. Please don't forget to leave us a review, as it would greatly help with visibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/c60b3374f0a5d112ba2d15a648a5ab454e09f041.jpg[/img]
Thank you for your time and hope to see you in the next one.
Happy gaming.

notes.title: Localisation update!
notes.content: We added localisation support for 10 languages including German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese Brazil, Russian, Turkish and Chinese (simplified). Stayed tuned for a more detailed blog post!

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update 17 | Achievement, Performance & Visual Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone and welcome to the 17th development update of Outliver: Tribulation, A Third-Person Action-Adventure Souls-Like Survival Horror shooter where you play as a soldier who mysteriously ends up in the Realm of Tribulations, a supernatural realm of African mythology where she unwillingly has to undergo an ancient ritual in the hopes of regaining passage back to her realm.

[previewyoutube=cPzMgO1ayc0;full][/previewyoutube]
In this update, we share with you the latest changes and additions we have made to the game based on our roadmap and recommendations from players. First of all, we updated the game from Unreal Engine 5.1 to 5.3 to take advantage of the awesome improvements the Epic Games team has made to the engine, especially in the performance department.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/a4072e3585c8b47a1df6627a6814bd641b214fdf.png[/img]
We also updated the visuals of the game by boosting the light exposures making the scenes generally brighter as well as adding more detail in general to the maps and most notably, overhauling the visuals of the Guardians Arena map, taking it from a plain and barren old look to a now more detailed and interesting look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/c562d020a4529f259f5b555f38f179ddb9124034.png[/img]
Based on a player's feedback, we worked on fixing some achievement bugs where achievements completed while playing offline don't update when you come online. Completed achievements are now saved and refreshed at regular intervals to update when next you play the game online. Also based on another player's very recent suggestion, we have added a new achievement to the game called "The Outliver" which unlocks after you have completed every other achievement in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/4d5393d4c76be3249f6fa026d6e7c704a78d0efb.png[/img]
Lastly, Outliver: Tribulation is currently on sale on Steam at a %60 discount! so make sure to get your copy now if you haven't already. I would also like to use this opportunity to say a very big thank you to everyone who has bought the game, your support will go a long way in helping us as a studio, all we need from you all now is to kindly leave us a review as this will help a lot with visibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/0d4be85f4718b98323cd31315f76a601691f4dcc.jpg[/img]
As always, we will continue to support Outliver: Tribulation and keep you guys updated as we go on, so make sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/czHZwNkMb6]discord server[/url], where we continue to keep the conversation on Outliver: Tribulation going. We’d love to have you there and hear your opinions and feedback, so please take a minute to join by using the link in the description below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/7109d7aed14d7675ce967c02676408276f74ca3c.png[/img]
Thank you for your time and we hope to see you in the next one.
Happy gaming.

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update #16 | New Features!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to this development update on our survival horror action game, Outliver: Tribulation, where you play as a soldier who mysteriously ends up in the Realm of Tribulations, a supernatural realm of African mythology where she unwillingly has to undergo an ancient ritual in the hopes of regaining passage back to her realm.

[previewyoutube=_7XHXhjXU1g;full][/previewyoutube]

Fresh off the heels of our last "Warchief" Update where we added two difficulty modes, a new achievement, a refreshed UI and more gameplay balance tweaks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/050d9952106de142b631562fe0fc695d850a5c59.png[/img]
We continued on with our commitment to supporting Outliver: Tribulation, and as a result, we have just released our newest update where we polished and improved the game by adding some much needed and requested features, all of which we will go through in today's update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/2796e422e6c1429ea905d2a9366623b5fb525aab.png[/img]
Firstly, based on user request and also in keeping up with modern convention, we have added a "Toggle" option for running, which is now the game's default option. You can also switch back to the older "press and hold" option to run in the settings menu for those who prefer that option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/7a62ff32846d9596d173faa05fc0a86708e4cb14.png[/img]
We have also seen situations where players don't immediately know where to go or what their actions have just accomplished. In this update, your player's camera now smoothly pans towards important locations or doors you have just unlocked as a result of solving riddles or completing quests among others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/80659e57abb9440d2ce02d43aa09339a69789167.png[/img]
Lastly, along with various bug fixes and additional balance tweaks, we also reduced the feeling of jerkiness by smoothing out the blending between various camera states and character movement animations, especially when you abruptly stop moving while running.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/5cb9ff517366acfa436cb6478c5eafc59ea64863.png[/img]
As always, we will continue to support Outliver: Tribulation and keep you updated as we go on, so make sure to get your copy now if you haven't already and don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/czHZwNkMb6]discord server[/url], where we continue to keep the conversation on Outliver: Tribulation going. We’d love to have you there and hear your opinions and feedback, so please take a minute to join by using the link in the description below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/7109d7aed14d7675ce967c02676408276f74ca3c.png[/img]
Thank you for your time and we hope to see you in the next one.
Happy gaming.

notes.title: Update (v1.2.0.2) Notes for Oct 23rd 2023
notes.content:
Hi everyone, The latest update for Outliver: Tribulation (v1.2.0.2) focuses on polish by adding:

- A "Run type" option to the settings where you can choose between toggling or hold the run button to run.

- A camera feedback where the camera moves to highlight points of interest or the result of players recent action like unlocking a door that could be out of players view.

- Improvements to blending between characters movement states to further smoothen it out

- Improvements to blending between camera's various positions.

- More balance tweaks to combat.

Aside from the above, we also made some other minor tweaks to the overall game to further improve the gameplay experience.

Best regards.
Mudathir

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update #15 | The War Chief Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to this development update on our survival horror action game, Outliver: Tribulation where you play as a soldier who mysteriously ends up in the Realm of Tribulations, a supernatural realm of African mythology where she unwillingly has to undergo an ancient ritual in the hopes of regaining passage back to her realm.

[previewyoutube=jdHFYgsr2XE;full][/previewyoutube]
It’s been one month since the launch of Outliver: Tribulation and we have been hard at work listening to and acting on feedback from the community. As a result, we are pleased to announce the release of the War Chief update based on user requests, where we split the game into two difficulty modes: the easy mode and the hard mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/73af6c9870a7e136ea2967ac9d21bec25aaf9578.png[/img]
- The easy mode is the current mode in the game where we’ve further reduced the difficulty to make the game more accessible. Enemies now have lower health and deal lesser damage to players. We also increased the interval between the wanderer's attack waves so players have more time to explore and solve riddles thereby making the gameplay much easier to get through. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/485c2e1e83786b4873a98ced4ddfce2b90a50d78.png[/img]
- The hard mode on the other hand is the new gameplay mode where things will be more challenging. Enemies in the hard mode have higher health and deal more damage to the players among other little tweaks which make the game more challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/ccb21bfd32ca1dc1ceb4aee783567aa477549926.png[/img]
- In order to encourage players to try out and beat the game in the new hard mode difficulty, we have added a new "War Chief" achievement to the game to go along with the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/050d9952106de142b631562fe0fc695d850a5c59.png[/img]
- We’ve also simplified the riddles by making the clues and instructions clearer and much easier to understand along with adjusting the damage you take from failing a riddle to be lower when playing in easy mode and higher when playing in hard mode.

- Lastly, we tweaked the UI of the game to make it more appealing and fixed the sound inconsistency issue some players complained about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/8641037164357c3c958abe3b1c6d5faf65ff679e.png[/img]
We hope this update makes the game a lot more fun to play. If you’ve already purchased the game, we say a big thank you to you for your support and can't wait to see your reviews and thumbs up on steam. And if you’re still undecided on getting the game, we hope this update encourages you to give it a try.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/2e358faf556cd2a4823309b712cc1b92305a2cdb.jpg[/img]
Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/czHZwNkMb6]discord [/url]server where we continue to keep the conversation on Outliver: Tribulation going. We’d love to have you there and hear your opinions and feedback, so please take a minute to join by using the following link - https://discord.com/invite/czHZwNkMb6


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/7109d7aed14d7675ce967c02676408276f74ca3c.png[/img]
Thank you for your time and we hope to see you in the next one.
Happy gaming.

notes.title: Update (v1.0.4.1) notes for July 20th 2023
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we have released a new update for Outliver: Tribulation (v1.0.4.1) where we worked on general gameplay and difficulty balance tweaks.

Combat difficulty - we reduced both health and damage output for all enemies across the board and other aspects to help players last longer and understand the enemies, thereby having more fun in combat.

Gameplay Pacing - we increased the interval between the wanderer's attack waves so players have more time to explore and solve riddles making the gameplay a bit more relaxed.

Riddles - we made the riddles more easier to understand by adding clearer instructions as well as making the clues to solving the riddles much easier to understand. We also drastically reduced the damage players take from failing a riddle.

Aside from the above, we made some other minor tweaks here and there, all of which we hope will make the gameplay experience more fun, so make sure to download the update if you have already downloaded the game to get the best experience.

Best regards.
Mudathir

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update #13 | More Tweaks + Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to this development update on our survival horror game, Outliver: Tribulation where you play as a soldier who mysteriously ends up in the Realm of Tribulations, a supernatural realm of African mythology where she unwillingly has to undergo an ancient ritual in the hopes of regaining passage back to her realm.

[previewyoutube=m72E_kZsmmo;full][/previewyoutube]

Following our last developer update, we received great feedback and have since gone on to make more tweaks to the game as we continue to polish it, and in today’s dev update, we’ll quickly go over some of the changes and tweaks we have made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/2cde3c0fcde82214457db5d56fe96eacc699f83a.png[/img]

First, we added a teleportation portal to the guardian’s arena map where the boss fights take place to allow you to leave the map before the battle starts if you feel you are not yet ready to face the guardian. This way, you have a choice to take on the boss fights only when you’re fully prepared and ready by upgrading your characters upgradables. Previously, you would be stuck here if you saved the game in the mystery passage leading to the guardian’s arena and would have to defeat the guardian before you can continue the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/ec9041d9793b60dc10aeca35d82d8ae6566d965e.png[/img]

We have also added Steam achievements to the game for players who love the extra challenge. We didn’t plan on implementing Steam achievements initially and instead chose to go for an in-game grading system that gets displayed when you complete the campaign but after much thought, and especially as we got close to launch, we decided to add the achievements for the completionists and hardcore players. As a result, we have added over 20 achievements for you to beat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/b2451e3ecee78bbc819100ffe4d7caae315e9b20.jpg[/img]

Moving on, after careful consideration of some very useful suggestions from the community, we added a mouse and gamepad look sensitivity adjustment option to the game settings to help players fine-tune the sensitivity of their various controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/f36f189176bc5e79ca83cc6c52033d222c6f906a.png[/img]

On the aesthetic side of things, still based on recommendations from the community, we added ripple effects to water surfaces when you walk over or shoot at them in order to add to the realism. We also added blood splatter effects on the dead bodies lying on the ground if you for some reason choose to shoot at them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/efae7495fbc08de8df0e3e61250d7d52b11984af.png[/img]

In general, we continued with combat and gameplay balancing tweaks whilst also testing and hunting for bugs so be sure to check out the demo we have on steam, wishlist, and recommend Outliver: Tribulation to friends and family if you haven't already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/da89e2a23e8b29dd5a475c9750c1f3377d03c91f.png[/img]

Also, don’t forget to join our newly launched [url=https://discord.gg/czHZwNkMb6]discord server[/url] where we continue to keep the conversation on Outliver: Tribulation going. We’d love to have you there and hear what you have to say, so please take a minute to join by clicking the link below. https://discord.gg/czHZwNkMb6


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/eb183bad2c80839ec9ffce13e72aa815a62fecb6.png[/img]

As always, we’ll continue to keep you updated as we progress through development and look forward to your valuable feedback. Thank you for your time and hope to see you in the next one.

Happy gaming.

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update #12 | More Tweaks + Discord!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to this development update on our survival horror game, Outliver: Tribulation where you play as a soldier who mysteriously ends up in a supernatural realm of African mythology and unwillingly has to take part in an ancient ritual.

[previewyoutube=FCycpwZ6ktM;full][/previewyoutube]

Following our last developer update and subsequent demo update release, we received a ton of interesting and useful feedback. In today’s update, we’ll quickly go over some of the changes we’ve made so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/344405dd641d83064772cc7ad0dcfa22acdc760b.png[/img]

First, we made some tweaks to the combat and ammo availability to balance out the difficulty and reduced the requirement for obtaining the Eldergun so players are able to acquire it much earlier in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/4314e1defd6933fa5bb9feb991a3be4f86bb72ec.png[/img]

We repositioned the charms’ cooldown, health, and spirit essence bars as well as added an ammo display for firearms when the aim button is pressed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/9fb471aff45b114826a206c459d8277eefc1b102.png[/img]

We added unique crosshairs for all firing modes of firearms and added a gunfire recoil effect as well as updated the rifle fire sound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/4570916ba38e7c0946759309302211d363416b3b.png[/img]

In order to give players a sense of progression, we added a popup that displays each new chapter a player just started. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/2796e422e6c1429ea905d2a9366623b5fb525aab.png[/img]

We made some tweaks to the menu and the main menu now sports a live background as opposed to the previous use of a static background picture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/4e1b5636dcb9ec512c34bd911e393f27bf4cc180.png[/img]

Following various suggestions, we reworked the night vision system by removing the binocular effect displayed on-screen and increased the light exposure. We also added a quick fade-in and fade-out effect signaling activation and deactivation of the night vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/36fd4ed0a4453479ca49082c9ae8daca8ff5dbb2.png[/img]

We updated the loading screen by adding a background image and included brief pop-ups of random tips on how to play the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/f6e5ea5f333b014d9fe46aa1223e4916a8348647.png[/img]

In general, we made minute tweaks to the whole game and will continue to test and hunt for bugs. We also hope to announce a release date soon and have updated the demo on steam to reflect these new changes, so, be sure to check it out, wishlist, and recommend Outliver: Tribulation to friends if you haven't already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/2b213ea3025ba873f940238265bb110e8c398a00.png[/img]

Moving on from updates, we are pleased to announce that we have just launched our own [url=https://discord.gg/czHZwNkMb6]discord server[/url] to keep the conversation on Outliver: Tribulation going. We’d love to have you there, so please join in using the link below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/c56495ee94d4e712b03244ebb90a538b8cacf7a3.png[/img]

As always, we will continue to keep you updated as we progress through development and look forward to your valuable feedback. Thank you for your time and hope to see you in the next one.

Happy gaming.

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update #11 | New Milestone!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to this developer update on our survival horror game, Outliver: Tribulation where you play as a soldier who mysteriously ends up in a supernatural realm of African mythology and unwillingly has to take part in an ancient ritual.

[previewyoutube=oAeOeiP4BW8;full][/previewyoutube]

Ever since our last developer update, we’ve been hard at work, updating and reworking some features of the game as we try to make sure it gets finished and released this year. Aside from some gameplay tweaks and optimizations, here are a few major changes we’ve implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/2e15635ea2f790c5906cc69b98e6d6eb807b9945.png[/img]

Thanks to recommendations and suggestions from the community, we have reworked the charms systems. As opposed to the charms being single-use items which are extremely limited in number throughout the whole game, you now only have to pick them up once and use as much as you like through the rest of the game with a cooldown period to prevent spamming. We find that this new approach makes the charms more useful in combat which in turn makes gameplay more fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/0c1835535d1beb01045c35ba2702743f8630abc0.png[/img]

The health charm was also pretty redundant since player health auto-regenerates. To counter this, we removed the health auto regen function, and this made gameplay more tense. Aside from using the health charm to regenerate health, the player’s health also gets refilled when you use the save terminal to save your game progress or after you defeat a boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/258d8db2ba17f0fa0addd903754ddf1aa00b37fd.png[/img]

We also worked on making the game feel more atmospheric by rebalancing the sound effects, ambiance, and music while also adding dynamic fog to the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/4f490f13649ed62c9a7f04407565e03fae80ca65.png[/img]

On the optimization side of things, we successfully updated the project to unreal 5.1 from 5.0 in order to take advantage of the new performance optimizations that come with the update. We also reworked the in-game settings to make sure they’re up to date and provide better performance when you choose between the various quality settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/44143d4fdd89c117eb76151056f0b7487f6f87b3.png[/img]

We also added a player grading/scoring system at the end of the game campaign for players to gauge their performance and maybe try again to get a better result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/32c0b995403370bb13e43573c83ac6a57ad8bd41.png[/img]

Finally, we are pleased to announce that Outliver: Tribulation is now playable from start to finish, in order words we have hit the Beta milestone. All that is left is to add localizations, clean up the project, continuously test, balance, and tweak the game as we receive more feedback and also port to other platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/54c152cbfceee9b7b144b207b073f94916cab205.png[/img]

As always, we’ll continue to share more information with you as we progress through the game’s development. Until then, kindly wishlist and recommend Outliver: Tribulation to friends and continue to share with us your thoughts and feedback about the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/d02ac083ea3a258b90938e31ed205a575b4fed4b.png[/img]

That would be all for now guys. Thanks so much for sticking around, and hope to see you in the next one. Happy gaming.

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation | Dev update #10 | Visual Overhaul + New Features
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to this developer update on our survival horror game, Outliver: Tribulation where you play as a soldier who mysteriously ends up in a fictional supernatural realm of African mythology and has to take part in an ancient ritual.

[previewyoutube=D1MftMT0jrI;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been hard at work implementing a host of changes to the game and taking into account the amazing and thoughtful feedback we received from the community in the steam fest event of October 2021.

We upgraded the game to unreal engine 5 from unreal engine 4 in order to take advantage of the new performance and visual features like Nanite and Lumen among others. As a result, we ended up rebuilding the world from scratch and are pleased with the new look we have achieved so far; let us know what you think once you’ve had a feel of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/d29bc99a8c5395f0ffd83658f5df05663c42fe38.png[/img]

For new features, we finally added voiced dialog sequences to the game during which the player still retains complete control of the camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/3ac20215231b137ebf018d9dd60429bbc263078a.png[/img]

We added a new powerful weapon called the Eldergun which has two firing modes; a mode where it acts as a typical shotgun and another where it acts as a rocket launcher. For its ammo, we repurposed the stamina system we previously removed for the running and diving systems and now refer to it as the spirit essence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/5166bb03ac3d7fb29f133cb7bbe455e60da81065.png[/img]

We also added a brand new player upgrade system which allows you to upgrade gameplay elements ranging from player health and spirit essence regeneration speed to improving the effectiveness of the various charms and Eldergun damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/1c115cf1bf47f3ea5c9f26a1507fc16fa4367f56.png[/img]

We overhauled the Map/Inventory system to now display useful information including points of interest like locked areas and important items, as well as player characters’ thoughts and current story arch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/6793b6a947958307e37849ccb046560b5090ff9d.png[/img]

On the gameplay side of things, we have replaced and added new mocap animations for certain action types. We also tweaked the timing and speed of certain actions to help make everything feel more responsive.
The teleportation system has also been upgraded. Now, all you need to do is to walk into the beam of light in the newly redesigned portal structure to teleport.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/31f1e977d612d3091b21e3bb37fbc3bd2a86309f.png[/img]

Unlocking barriers now involves interacting with certain terminals as opposed to previously interacting with the barriers directly. This was done to make the world have more man-made elements to it.

On the combat side of things, we have updated and added new enemy types as well as made them more aggressive and challenging. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/cb064515a36529eea4f25188d36e80476697ae4d.png[/img]

As for performance optimizations, we are actively working on making sure the game is as stable as possible and this will continue till launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/5f29d806ae84b69d1b2c49a82302c4d799fdceff.png[/img]

We will be sharing more information as we progress through the development. Until then, we are pleased to announce we have released a new Demo on steam for you to try out which will be available for a limited time, so, please check it out and wishlist it if you haven’t done so already. Also, kindly recommend it to friends and continue to share with us your thoughts and feedback about the game.

That would be all for now guys. Thanks so much for sticking around, and hope to see you in the next one. Happy gaming.

[previewyoutube=wLzfZPm07Xs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Outliver: Tribulation Dev Update #7
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to our latest  dev update. My name is Mudathir Giwa, co-founder and team lead at GBROSSOFT, a studio made up of a team of three and based in Lagos, southwest Nigeria.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/aa5a68ec5613ec2c8bc4de1943faa9c86c29b373.gif[/img]

We would like to use this post to share with you the latest update on our current in-development game Outliver: Tribulation and will be giving a brief summary of what the game is about and what to expect while playing.

[previewyoutube=L3WkAugkYCs;full][/previewyoutube]
Outliver: Tribulation is a third-person survival horror game set in a fictional supernatural realm of African mythology about a soldier on the run from terrorists who mysteriously finds herself in the middle of an ancient ritual. You play as Bola, the leader of a special ops unit whose team while on a search and rescue mission for another unit code named the Dagger squad gets ambushed by Boko Haram terrorists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/9e4d11b3dbad62255bc5cea130d69cb4857307eb.png[/img]

Bola emerges as the sole survivor of this ambush and while on the run, she ends up in the realm of tribulations, an ancient supernatural realm where she finds out she has to pass a trial before being allowed passage back to her realm. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/c5b0d5c2ea9e99967aeddd6fd6071f1ba54b5f27.png[/img]

During the course of the game, players will get to uncover the mystery behind the realm, know the fate of dagger squad, meet other characters, solve riddles, engage monsters in intense battles, utilise night vision goggles to see better in the dark and teleport via portals to various parts of the realm, while making use of various charms and weapons to stay alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36706431/ec40be709a0ad4738639a2e27d740de7caac7842.png[/img]

We hope this short description has piqued your interest in Outliver: Tribulation. Please do take the time to try our demo which is currently live on steam and don’t forget to Wishlist it afterwards.

Thank you,
The Gbrossoft Team.
